instruction:
Pack the jobs in input/jobs_a.jsonl and input/jobs_b.jsonl into batches: write output/plan_a.jsonl and output/plan_b.jsonl, one line per job, `{"id": ..., "batch": <int>, "slot": <int>}`. The rules and the scoring are in score.py (`python3 score.py input/jobs_a.jsonl output/plan_a.jsonl` scores a plan); baseline.py writes a valid plan that is far too costly. Each plan must meet its limits:

| Plan | cost | waste | p95_wait |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| output/plan_a.jsonl | at most 1.55e7 | at most 0.53 | at most 1.6e3 |
| output/plan_b.jsonl | at most 1.53e7 | at most 0.32 | at most 2.3e3 |

And across both plans combined, at most 6 distinct slot sizes. Don't change the inputs or score.py.
